title: Limit CI push trigger to main to stop duplicate PR runs
summary: Restrict ci.yml's push trigger to main (keeping pull_request, workflow_dispatch, schedule) with a comment explaining why, record the decision with PR #185 timings in docs/decisions.md, and add a CHANGELOG entry. Goal: one CI run per PR commit, so landing stops waiting on duplicate 16-minute push runs.

defaults_applied.how: Decision entry cites PR #185 timings as given in the request.
Comment and decision written for an outside reader.
The trigger restriction is enforced by the workflow itself.
Criterion on one run per commit after landing.
One focused change across three named files.
cargo test and clippy still pass.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal: cut duplicate CI runs on PR branches so landing stops waiting ~16 min; audience is Athena maintainers and the landing flow.
Use `push: branches: [main]`; main is the default branch (cache saving already keyed on default-branch push).
Decision number follows the latest D-number in docs/decisions.md (D121 is referenced in ci.yml).
The post-landing observation criterion cannot be verified by the producer; recorded as a follow-up.

acceptance_criteria.text: .github/workflows/ci.yml's `on.push` is `branches: [main]` only, with pull_request, workflow_dispatch and the weekly schedule unchanged, and a comment saying why (push runs use a different cache scope and miss the pull-request run's cached pass; PR #185 ran twice for 16 min extra).

docs/decisions.md has a new decision entry, numbered after the latest, with alternatives and the PR #185 timings (pull_request run 26 s via cached pass; two push runs ~16 min; landing waited 17m51s), labeled as taken from the request.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry under [Unreleased] (Changed) describing the push trigger limit.
Required checks remain satisfied by the pull_request run: job name 'fmt, clippy, tests' is unchanged and no other workflow or config edits are made.
Header comment in ci.yml that refers to the cache scope remains consistent with the new trigger.
cargo test and cargo clippy pass (including any xtask/tests that parse ci.yml or check docs/changelog consistency).
Outcome check: the next landing's PR shows one run per commit; this can only be observed after landing and is noted in the decision as a follow-up, not claimed as done.

out_of_scope: Changing cache scopes, cache keys or the pass-marker logic
Changing job names or branch protection settings
departures: Small three-file edit, so cost and time are below the reference; the post-landing criterion adds some verification risk.
urgent_reason: Removes duplicate 16-minute push runs that the landing waits on, cutting wasted time on every landing.
